## MigrationGraph.migrateAsync() method

Execute an async migration from one version to another. Use this when any migration in the path might be async.

**Signature:**

```typescript
migrateAsync<T>(data: unknown, fromVersion: string, toVersion: string, options?: MigrateOptions): Promise<MigrationResult<T>>;
```
